text_block_list.text:
S-so, how'd I do, Тренер? I think I
moved pretty
well out there!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Or maybe... I'm completely wrong?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Woo! Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Now I can finally report some good news
to my
Mejiro fam!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Grandma expects me to enter the
Classics fast,
but at least I can tell her
that I made my debut for
now.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
While still far from meeting all her
grandmother's
expectations, this is a big
first stЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you too, Ines. It's all because I
had your
support!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on. Don't worry about me. I'm
your
trusty sidekick after all!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: Well, see ya!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: Huh? Where ya going, Ines?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I have to get ready for my own debut
race, just
like you did.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
I may not be in the Mejiro family, but
your
roommate has her own humble
life. ♪
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
The story will continue tonight, when I
get back
to the dorm!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
And off she goes... Now it's just the two
of us.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I feel a little lonely...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But you'll always be with me, won't you?
Friends
forever, right?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
What a relief. I'm still a newbie, but I'm
looking
forward to a long relationship!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: ...Wait. Why'd I say it like that?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
"A long relationship"? That sounds like...
oh
gosh... like we're newlyweds!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Please forget what I just said! Anyway,
I'll keep
doing my best in the next race!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан makes it through her debut
safely,
but her next race will be a true
test of her
strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I settle on the Junior Cup as our next
goal. She
needs to make a name for
herself in an early-year
open race to
move on to the Classics.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
